title: Some Important thing need to know before deep dive into AI Development
summary: Some Important thing need to know before deep dive into AI Development
content:
## There have so many topics in AI.
Mostly are AI, ML, DL, NN, RAG, Agents, MCP and so many things.
But we have to decide `What I want to learn` before learning.

There are mostly two type of development in AI
1. AI Research
2. GenAI
### Where I was wrong?
When I wanted to learn AI I always go to the end line of ai means the first step of `AI Research`. Then I become frustated. 
I am a **full stack web developer**. So I want to build AI Integrated application. 
Then I realize I don't need to learn these much about LLM internals so deeply. I should learn about the optimization of usage of **LLM models, its memory, conext, sequrity**. 
In `Object Oriented Programming` , I learned about **Abstruction**. And this is what the abstruction is.
So I just learn **high level design** of `how LLM works`.

Although I am learning `Machine Learning`. But thats not for this. I am learning this out of curiosity.

Until now I learned about `different types of prompt`, ` internal tool calling` .
